diagrams.title: Asset Lifecycle: Procure → Deploy → Manage → Decommission
diagrams.subtitle: Click each step to see the controls to apply and the evidence it produces.

nodes.label: Plan / scope
nodes.detail: Define the need, business criticality, security requirements, and expected lifespan before any spending.
nodes.exam: Without planning, purchasing creates a shadow asset.

nodes.label: Procure
nodes.detail: Include encryption, support duration, compliance, and certified sanitization capability in the procurement requirements.
nodes.exam: Security requirements are written before purchase, not after.

nodes.label: Deploy
nodes.detail: Assign an owner, register the asset in inventory, label it, and document authorized use.
nodes.exam: The asset record links owner, criticality, version, and processed data.

nodes.label: Manage
nodes.detail: Track patches, movements, and usage via network discovery, MDM, and CMDB; detect shadow IT.
nodes.exam: A discrepancy between inventory and reality signals a rogue device to investigate.

nodes.label: Decommission
nodes.detail: Sanitize or destroy media, revoke accounts and licenses, respect legal holds, and produce a certificate of destruction.
nodes.exam: Disposal without evidence leaves the asset exposed to data theft.
